node.title: E22 dyadic local-to-common saturation
node.statement: In a dyadic E22 domain, if a fixed tail B is removed and each local non-tail block is saturated on full fibers of some dyadic quotient map x -> x^{M_i} with M_i>t, then the union of all local non-tail blocks is saturated on full fibers of the minimum local modulus M_* = min_i M_i, and M_*>t.
node.attack_surface: dyadic quotient moduli form a divisibility chain, so larger-modulus fibers refine into fibers of the minimum local modulus
node.falsifier: dyadic quotient moduli M_*<M_i where a full M_i-fiber is not a union of full M_*-fibers
